name: derivational_suffix
description: Identify productive English derivational suffixes from base/derived word pairs; matched control returns the base word.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
groups={'ly':['quick','slow','kind','neat','calm','loud','soft','safe','clear','fair','bold','bad','sad','warm','quiet'], 'ness':['kind','dark','weak','sad','calm','neat','soft','bold','cold','cool','tall','short','sweet','thick','still'], 'less':['care','hope','fear','harm','help','use','pain','power','home','end','rest','sleep','speech','worth','thought'], 'ful':['care','hope','fear','harm','help','use','pain','power','joy','peace','cheer','color','grace','skill','thought']}
items=[];control=[]
for suffix,bases in groups.items():
 for base in bases:
  word=base+suffix
  for form in range(2):
   record=f'Base word: {base}. Derived word: {word}.' if form==0 else f'Word formation: {base} -> {word}.'
   # Compute the suffix by removing the supplied root.
   answer=word[len(base):]
   items.append({'prompt':f'Identify the suffix added to the base word.\n{record}\nAnswer: "','answer':answer+'"'})
   control.append({'prompt':f'Identify the base word before the suffix was added.\n{record}\nAnswer: "','answer':base+'"'})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
